listing.title: Munchly Masala Chips 150 g, 784 packs, Nagpur
listing.description: Lot of 784 packs of Munchly Masala Chips 150 g (batch MF-2409-117) with best before 18 Nov 2026. Stock is located at Kalamna Market godown, Nagpur, at an asking price of ₹15 a pack. Dispatch is within 24 hours of the balance.

chat.text: We can offer the 784 packs at ₹14.20 per pack. Dispatch will be within 24 hours of the balance.

feed.text: Checked 9 batches across 4 distributors. MF-2409-117 fails all three quick-commerce gates and will not sell through.
Asked Rakesh Traders for one label photo before quoting any price.
Sent one photo of the carton label from shelf B4.
Read the label: batch MF-2409-117, MFG 18 May 2026, best before 18 Nov 2026, MRP ₹30.00, confidence 0.98. Matches the DMS record.
Priced five channels against 46 days left. Destroying costs −₹19.36 a unit, −₹26,562 for the batch.

We send 588 units to the Kirana cluster at ₹18 each to fill their capacity for the 14 days left, and 784 units to ExpireSoon at ₹15. Staff sale gets nothing as it pays less, giving us a swing against writing the batch off of ₹26,560.
Sent Priya the plan to review, and Rakesh bhai the same plan with a pause button.
Approved the plan from the phone.
Pushed the Hindi scheme to 38 kiranas in the Nagpur cluster: buy 10 get 2 for 48 hours, no shop over 4× its own 14-day sales.
Posted 784 units on ExpireSoon in Rakesh Traders' name at ₹15, with the label photo and dates. Reserve ₹13.50; hidden from buyers inside Munchly's territories.
31 of 38 kiranas ordered all 588 units in about 30 hours, each under its cap.
Agrawal Wholesale bid ₹13 for all 784, below the reserve. Countered at ₹14.20 with 24-hour dispatch from Rakesh bhai's calendar.
Accepted ₹14.20 and paid the ₹1,670 token.
Loaded Agrawal Wholesale's truck for Raipur once the balance landed.
Drafted Rakesh's invoice INV/26-27/0931 for Rakesh to issue, checked the e-way bill rule, issued the price-support credit note CN/0118 and wrote the ITC memo.
Ran the Friday round: 31 drops, 588 packets.
Expiry day: the journey closed as it stood, with every pack gone.
Expiry day called on 10 Oct, before the return window would close on 29 Oct. Posted the ledger: 219.5 kg diverted, 548.8 kg CO₂e avoided (indicative), 0 meals. BRSR row written.
